# Part 2 — Outreach

Personalisation is only as good as what the pipeline kept. It turned out the pipeline was throwing it away.

## Discovery was discarding what personalisation needs

`2026-07-10T00:19:52.069Z` · session `cc29f4e9` · branch `creator-outreach-pipeline-f4e86f`

**The engine put a decision to Doug, and he answered:**

> **Q.** The spec's outreach pipeline lists "transcript → recent captions → audience comments" as the personalisation inputs, but discovery throws captions away — Airtable only keeps the bio, segment, keywords, strength/weakness. What should feed the personalisation variables?
>
> **A.** Captions + comments (Recommended)
>
> **Q.** The brief asks for "first touch and follow ups". How should the engine produce the sequence?
>
> **A.** Full 3-touch sequence upfront (Recommended)
>

**What changed because of it:** The spec said outreach personalises on captions and comments. Discovery kept only bio, segment and keywords — it was writing the captions to /dev/null. Two documents, both internally consistent, jointly wrong. Caught by reading them against each other rather than in sequence.
